name: Shintotsukawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shintotsukawa town emblem in black: an outlined lozenge enclosing a cross.
history: Municipal flag of Shintotsukawa, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Shintotsukawa town emblem — an outlined lozenge enclosing a cross
